issue_context.title: Add an EVP demo for RSA key generation
issue_context.body:
Generate a 4096 bit key.  Include a validation step (separate function).

It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.
comments: Is the ask here to add an example of an RSA key generation code snippet to the respective man page(s)?

It is adding a new program to the demo directory that generates an RSA key.
It's fine to do more, e.g. save to PEM file.
FWIW, I closed the pull request because I don't have my employer's permission to contribute it.

review_comments: EVP_PKEY_print_private() is an easier way of doing this...
That's true, though the idea was really to show how to retrieve the individual components of the key. Printing them is mostly an excuse for that.
The EC one is doing the same,so it is consistent with that one..
